description: This file defines the SecurityContext class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, implementing the PluginHost::ISecurity interface. It includes a nested Payload class for JSON serialization of security-related data and provides methods for security checks such as Allowed() and Token().

classes.name: SecurityContext
classes.description: Implements security context management, including access control and token handling.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: A JSON container class for serializing URL, user, and hash information related to security context.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the security context with access control list, payload, and service prefix.

methods.description: Checks if websocket upgrade is allowed for the given path.

methods.description: Checks if a web request is allowed.

methods.description: Checks if a JSONRPC message is allowed.
